scope: One scratch-only attempt to convert a locally authored MLINE DXF to AC1018 for a parser-source screen

result.failure: The converter aborted before conversion with macOS pasteboard/XPC errors, including pasteboard error [-4960].

latest_launch_probe.result: The app still aborted before conversion with the same pasteboard [-4960] and hiservices XPC errors. The exact MLINE conversion was not retried because the launch prerequisite failed.

post_unlock_launch_probe.trigger: The user reported unlocking the macOS session after the prior failed launch probe.
post_unlock_launch_probe.sessionStateObservation: launchctl print gui/502 no longer exposed CGSSessionScreenIsLocked; the GUI state could not be independently confirmed from this shell.
post_unlock_launch_probe.result: The app aborted before conversion; its log again reports pasteboard [-4960] for clipboard/find and invalid hiservices XPC connections.

bundle_open.result: LaunchServices rejected the bundle with NSOSStatusErrorDomain Code=-10827 (kLSNoExecutableErr), although Contents/MacOS/ODAFileConverter exists and is executable.

signature_check.result: invalid signature (code or signature have been modified); In architecture: arm64

accessibility_probe.command: System Events query for the ODAFileConverter process name and frontmost state
accessibility_probe.result: AppleScript returned error -10827; no usable UI state was established.

launchservices_bundle_probe.interpretation: The launchd application job alone is not a normal usable launch: it is started suspended, LaunchServices rejects the bundle, and signature verification fails. This is an installation/bundle blocker, not evidence about MLINE parsing.

disposition.unblock_condition: A valid official macOS ARM64 ODA bundle passes signature verification and opens through LaunchServices in a usable session.
disposition.next_action: Do not retry conversion until the installed bundle passes codesign verification and LaunchServices starts it unsuspended. Then convert the exact existing scratch source once; do not regenerate it or add either file to repository fixtures.
